title: Sour Cream Skillet Cornbread

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: 3 Tbsp melted butter, slightly cooled, plus 1 Tbsp for pan

steps: Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet on the middle rack and preheat oven to 425°F.
Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk sour cream, buttermilk, eggs, 3 Tbsp melted butter and oil. Whisk the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients.
Carefully remove the hot skillet, add 1 Tbsp butter and swirl to coat. Pour in batter.
Bake about 20 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes in the pan, then turn onto a rack and cool 10 minutes more. Serve warm.
